patterns.note: Dark-themed full-width sections with high-contrast white text, creating a sophisticated and modern aesthetic.
Dynamic, asymmetrical grid layouts are used prominently in the hero section to showcase diverse use cases and in content sections for resources and articles.
Very large, bold, uppercase sans-serif typography is employed as impactful section dividers or statements, such as the 'PERFORMANCE' text, to create strong visual anchors.
The primary color scheme features a deep charcoal background with crisp white text, accented by a vibrant blue for interactive elements and a secondary orange for highlights.
Sections and content blocks reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport during scroll, enhancing engagement.
The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent background to a solid dark background and becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after initial scroll.

technique_notes: A dark, high-contrast visual theme is established with a deep charcoal background and bright white text, ensuring readability and a modern, premium aesthetic across the site.
Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate scroll-triggered animations, revealing content sections with a staggered fade-up or slide-in effect as they become visible in the viewport.
The main navigation bar employs a sticky behavior, initially transparent and full-width, then shrinking slightly and gaining a solid dark background after the user scrolls past the hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-5x body) with clear, legible body text and smaller uppercase labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons, cards, and input fields, creating a soft, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with airy hero and large typographic sections, transitioning to a more structured grid density for feature and resource listings.

standout: The site stands out with its sophisticated dark theme, employing a dynamic, asymmetrical grid in the hero that feels less static than typical hero sections. The use of extremely large, bold typography as a visual statement (e.g., 'PERFORMANCE') creates a powerful, almost architectural feel, elevating key messages beyond standard headings.
